description: Source code implementing optimized linear operations for XPU using MKL-DNN, including functions for collapsing tensor dimensions and performing pointwise linear transformations with optional bias and binary operations.

methods.name: collapse_in_out_dim
methods.description: Collapses input tensor dimensions for matrix multiplication, returning reshaped sizes.

methods.name: linear_pointwise
methods.description: Performs a pointwise linear transformation on input tensor with optional bias and algorithm.

methods.name: linear_pointwise_binary
methods.description: Performs a binary pointwise linear operation involving two input tensors.
